Name: Erossavia's Dark Brown Brick Path
Author: Erossavia
Description: This is a Content Patcher compatible path replacement mod. By default, it changes the gravel path to a Dark Brown Brick recolor I did, but you can change which path is replaced by tweaking the config file.
